caseName: Atlantic, Gulf & Pacific Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: ATLANTIC, GULF & PACIFIC COMPANY v. THE UNITED STATES and THE UNITED STATES v. THE ATLANTIC, GULF & PACIFIC COMPANY

opinions.text:
No opinion was delivered by the court below, but judgment was rendered in favor of the United States.

Per curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs by an equally divided court, June 3, 1918.
